description: This Java class 'WidgetsBundleDataValidator' extends 'DataValidator' to perform validation logic for 'WidgetsBundle' objects, including validation of data fields, creation, and update constraints within the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: WidgetsBundleDataValidator
classes.description: A validator class for WidgetsBundle objects, ensuring data integrity and business rules compliance during creation and update operations.

methods.name: validateDataImpl
methods.description: Validates the WidgetsBundle data, ensuring the title is valid and the tenant ID exists if specified.

methods.name: validateCreate
methods.description: Generates a unique alias for the WidgetsBundle if not provided, ensuring no duplicates exist for the same tenant.

methods.name: validateUpdate
methods.description: Ensures the WidgetsBundle update does not change tenant association or alias in an unauthorized manner.
